title: Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention for Efficient Inference in T2I/T2V Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: Sink-Sparse混合注意力：面向T2I/T2V扩散Transformer的高效推理方法

paragraphs.en: 该文提出免训练的Sink-Sparse混合注意力，通过离线校准复用稀疏掩码并辅以池化KV分支，为文生图和文生视频扩散Transformer实现1.5倍以上推理加速。 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a common backbone for high-quality text-to-image and text-to-video generation, but repeated dense self-attention remains a major inference bottleneck as token sequences grow and the same operator is invoked across many denoising steps. Our study suggests that dense attention in pretrained DiTs contains reusable layer/head-specific high-mass structure that can be identified from a small offline calibration set and reused across future generations. This leads to Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention, a train-free attention replacement that reuses static sink masks and supplements them with a lightweight pooled-KV branch, while leaving model weights and sampling schedules unchanged. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, the method attains 1.54$\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining generation quality. On Z-Image-Turbo, it attains 1.57$\times$ end-to-end speedup with competitive GenEval2 performance. These results indicate that reusable importance-aware sparse support can provide an effective train-free acceleration path for both T2V and T2I DiTs.
paragraphs.zh: 该文提出免训练的Sink-Sparse混合注意力，通过离线校准复用稀疏掩码并辅以池化KV分支，为文生图和文生视频扩散Transformer实现1.5倍以上推理加速。扩散Transformer（DiTs）已成为高质量文生图和文生视频生成的常见骨干网络，但随着token序列增长以及同一算子在多个去噪步骤中被反复调用，重复的稠密自注意力仍然是主要的推理瓶颈。 我们的研究表明，预训练DiT中的稠密注意力包含可复用的、特定于层/注意力头的高质量（high-mass）结构，这些结构可以从小型离线校准集中识别出来，并在未来的生成任务中复用。 由此产生了Sink-Sparse混合注意力，这是一种免训练的注意力替换方案，它复用静态sink掩码，并辅以轻量的池化KV分支，同时保持模型权重和采样调度不变。 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上，该方法实现了1.54倍的端到端加速，同时保持了生成质量。 在Z-Image-Turbo上，该方法实现了1.57倍的端到端加速，并取得了具有竞争力的GenEval2性能。 这些结果表明，可复用的、重要性感知的稀疏支持可以为文生视频和文生图DiT提供一条有效的免训练加速路径。
